title: Understanding Bootstrap Estimates
text: To find the bootstrap estimate for the variance of the sample mean, focus on the rowmeans. The variance of these rowmeans will give you the estimate you need.

title: Choosing the Correct Statistic
text: Which statistic should you use to estimate the variance of the sample mean?

title: Calculating Variance
text: Remember, variance is calculated by taking the average of the squared differences from the mean. Apply this to the rowmeans to find the variance.
